Explain the method behind an assessment score
An undocumented scoring rule gives your team little support when a result is questioned.
Codility shares its technical manual with prospective and existing clients and updates the manual every six months.
The methodology aligns with the Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing.
Codility also provides adverse impact analysis at cut scores.
Your reviewers can examine differences in results across candidate groups.
Your procurement and legal reviewers can examine supporting documentation before your team adopts the assessment.
Investigate a result without watching every session

Screen provides behavioral signals, similarity checks and identity-verification evidence for review.
Integrity Risk summarizes contributing signals in a reviewable risk level.

Security and data handling
Codility is SOC 2 Type II audited and ISO 27001 certified. You can choose EU or US data hosting. Codility does not train AI models on candidate data.
